_note: Three real curves, read live from chain 4663 on 2026-09-06 and recorded in RESEARCH-PHASE2-3.md section A2. The wei values are exactly what eth_call returned. Frozen: these are historical readings, not live data, and they must never be refreshed from the chain — the graduated one in particular is a permanent record of the drain behaviour.

graduated.why: a graduated token: the curve was drained, so every balance reads 0 and a naive ratio would render 0% for a launch that filled all the way

dead.why: launched, never graduated: one wei of quote survived the fees, so the fill is a real 0.0000% and not a missing reading

live.why: mid-curve, ETH-paired: the quote side reads 53.45% while the token side reads 73.92% at the same instant, which is why only one of them is published
